description: gamma-gamma bonds (products of 1..3 vertices sigma_i sigma_{i+1}^-1, i in 0..3, 84 words) appended to X Y^(3) in H_6; mu = tr(atom)/tr(free) for pp,pn,np,nn, exact Markov trace at z_D. Pattern = pn,np < 1 and pp,nn > 1. Preregistered in preregistration.md.

assertions.name: q=1: mu_pp = mu_pn = mu_np = mu_nn for every word
q=1: pattern holds for no word
q0: nuc2_only words: mu depends only on nucleon 2 (overlap theorem)
q0: nuc1_only words: mu depends only on nucleon 1 (mirror control)
q0: 'both' words avoiding generator 2: mu_pp*mu_nn = mu_pn*mu_np exactly (towerTr_gapBond_crossRatio)
q0: 'both' words with ONE gap letter: cross-ratio identity exactly (towerTr_singleGapBond_crossRatio)
q0: every mu > 0 (so mu < 1 / mu > 1 is the binding test)
